text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_mssql_server.orders","doc_id":"POL-004","attribute":"administrator_login","title":"azurerm_mssql_server.orders will be replaced because \"administrator_login\" changes to \"ordersadmin\", and replacing a SQL Server can destroy data it holds unless it is backed up or disposable.","suggestion":"Confirm the server and its databases are backed up or intentionally disposable before applying, or change the plan to avoid the replacement.","breaks_standard":true}]}
